#include <iostream>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    long long n;
    long long a[16];
    a[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i < 16; ++i) {
        a[i] = a[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
    }
    cin >> n;

    function<long long(long long, int)> solve = [&](long long n, int step) -> long long {
        long long ans = (step + 1LL) * (n / a[step]);
        n %= a[step];
        if (n == 0) return ans;
        long long res1 = solve(n, step - 1);
        long long res2 = step + 1 + solve(a[step] - n, step - 1);
        return ans + min(res1, res2);
    };

    cout << solve(n, 15) << "\n";
    return 0;
}
